title: I went to ___ / I stayed ___.
goal_hi: Pichle weekend kya kiya, past simple me batana.

forms.positive: I went to my cousin's place and stayed there for two hours.
forms.negative: I didn't go out on Sunday.
forms.question: Where did you go on Sunday?

pattern.note_hi: went = go ka past; stayed = ghar ya kisi jagah ruka.

examples.en: I went to my cousin's place and stayed there for two hours.
examples.hi: Main cousin ke ghar gaya aur do ghante wahan raha.

examples.en: I went to the market in the morning.
We stayed home and watched a movie.
examples.hi: Hum ghar par ruke aur movie dekhi.

examples.en: I didn't go out on Sunday.
examples.hi: Main Sunday ko bahar nahi gaya.

examples.en: She went to the theatre with her friends.
examples.hi: Woh apne doston ke saath theatre gayi.

words.example_en: I went to my cousin's place.
We went to the theatre on Saturday.
We made a plan for Sunday.

words.example_hi: Mujhe ghar ka khana pasand hai.

dialogue.title: Friend catch-up
dialogue.context_hi: Sunday shaam, friend se phone par weekend ki baat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It was good. I went to my cousin's place.
lines.hi: Achha tha. Main cousin ke ghar gaya.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice. Did you stay there long?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About two hours. Then we went to the theatre.
lines.hi: Lagbhag do ghante. Phir hum theatre gaye.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sounds fun. I stayed home and slept.
lines.hi: Maza aaya hoga. Main ghar par raha aur soya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's a good plan too. I didn't sleep enough.
lines.hi: Wo bhi achha plan hai. Mujhe poori neend nahi mili.

sound_focus.tip_hi: went ka final /t/ clear bolo. 'I wen home' nahi — 'I went home'.

scenario.setting_hi: Sunday shaam friend phone par weekend poochta hai.

turns.hint_hi: Achha tha, cousin ke ghar gaye the.
turns.model_en: It was good. I went to my cousin's place.
About two hours. Then we went to the theatre.

turns.prompt_en: Did you go out on Sunday?
turns.hint_hi: Nahi, Sunday ko bahar nahi gaye, ghar par rahe.
turns.model_en: No, I didn't go out on Sunday. I stayed home.

turns.prompt_en: What did you do at home?
turns.hint_hi: Movie dekhi aur neend poori ki.
turns.model_en: I watched a movie and got some sleep.

quiz.answer: I went to the market on Sunday.
options: I went to the market on Sunday.
I go to the market on Sunday.
I went to market in Sunday.
